title: Odyssey-3 Pro Sets Record 66.1 Score on Physics IQ Benchmark
summary:
The AI startup Odyssey has released a foundation world model that generates simulated environments and interactive experiences from text prompts in real time. The Odyssey-3 Pro version scored 66.1 on the Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video benchmark, the highest score reported for the test, and is currently available for free public access.

The model evaluates physical behavior across optics, solid mechanics, and fluid dynamics by predicting how real-world physics experiments continue. In robotics applications, the AI demonstrated emergent capabilities such as a robotic arm recovering from a missed grasp, a behavior that the developer noted was absent from the model's training demonstrations.

People and AI agents can act inside these worlds and observe how they respond, creating potential uses in simulation, robotics and training AI through experience.

The benchmark tests physical behavior in areas such as fluid dynamics, optics and solid mechanics.
